caption:
A 90th-minute strike secures the win! Jose Mourinho returns to Real Madrid with a dramatic 2-1 victory over Espanyol.

Real Madrid secured a 2-1 victory over Espanyol in LaLiga on Saturday, marking the start of Jose Mourinho's second stint as manager of the club.

Jude Bellingham opened the scoring for Los Blancos, heading home a free-kick from Arda Guler. However, Alex Calatrava leveled the game for Espanyol in the 30th minute.

The match remained deadlocked until the 90th minute when substitute Carlos Espi capitalized on a loose ball in the box to score the winning goal.

Mourinho's starting lineup featured stars like Kylian Mbappe and Vinicius Junior, alongside debuts for Bernardo Silva, Denzel Dumfries, and Ibrahima Konate.

The Portuguese veteran returns to the club 13 years after his first departure, tasked with ending Barcelona's domestic dominance and stabilizing the dressing room.

Other LaLiga results included Sevilla winning 3-1 against Athletic Bilbao, while Valencia and Celta Vigo played to a 0-0 draw.

headline_marked: Olise shines as [[Bayern Munich win German Supercup]] 2-1
headline: Olise shines as Bayern Munich win German Supercup 2-1
summary: Michael Olise scored and assisted as Bayern secured their 12th title in a hard-fought victory over Borussia Dortmund.
details: Bayern Munich claimed the German Supercup for the 12th time, defeating Borussia Dortmund 2-1 in the season-opening clash on Saturday.
Michael Olise was the standout performer, providing an assist for Nathaniel Brown's 28th-minute opener and scoring a goal himself just before halftime.
Borussia Dortmund attempted a comeback with a late goal from Fabio Silva, but they were unable to find an equalizer despite several late chances.
The match saw high drama in the final minutes, including a red card for Dortmund's Ramy Bensebaini and a missed golden opportunity by Maximilian Beier.
Bayern coach Vincent Kompany expressed confidence in his side's hunger to repeat last year's success, while Harry Kane described the win as a magnificent start to the season.
This victory marks Bayern's second consecutive title since the trophy was renamed the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup in 2025.
caption:
Bayern Munich kick off the season with silverware! 🏆

Bayern Munich claimed the German Supercup for the 12th time, defeating Borussia Dortmund 2-1 in the season-opening clash on Saturday.

Michael Olise was the standout performer, providing an assist for Nathaniel Brown's 28th-minute opener and scoring a goal himself just before halftime.

Borussia Dortmund attempted a comeback with a late goal from Fabio Silva, but they were unable to find an equalizer despite several late chances.

The match saw high drama in the final minutes, including a red card for Dortmund's Ramy Bensebaini and a missed golden opportunity by Maximilian Beier.

Bayern coach Vincent Kompany expressed confidence in his side's hunger to repeat last year's success, while Harry Kane described the win as a magnificent start to the season.

This victory marks Bayern's second consecutive title since the trophy was renamed the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup in 2025.
